description: This Swift source file defines the enum `DeviceInfoHelper` that provides utility static methods to gather and format device and app platform information such as OS version, device family, model identifier, app version, and build details. It is used for displaying device info in settings, payloads, and device status within the application.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string with the platform name ('iOS' or 'iPadOS') and OS version, e.g., 'iOS 18.0.0'.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a display string with OS name and version, e.g., 'iOS 18.0.0'.

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns a string representing device family ('iPad', 'iPhone', or 'iOS').

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the device's model identifier string, e.g., 'iPhone17,1'.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Returns the app's marketing version as specified in the bundle info, e.g., '2026.2.0'.

methods.name: appBuild
methods.description: Returns the app's build number string.

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Returns a combined version/build string for display, e.g., '1.2.3' or '1.2.3 (456)'.
